title: FraudGuard
summary: A fraud-detection project centered on a notebook that builds a synthetic click/fraud dataset, deriving table metadata and fitting a copula-based generator before checking data quality. SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer is run via sdv.single_table, with SingleTableMetadata and evaluate_quality used to build and validate the synthetic data.
needs: No README; industry domain inferred from 'click_duration' fraud fields, could also be media_recommenders/finance_insurance.
